reviews.text: Hi, Lucy. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!
Hi, Adrian.  Thank you so much for your kind review and trust with your furry family member. We look forward to seeing you both again soon!

I go here only because it’s on the same block as my apartment but I hate this place. The people who work here are not friendly and it’s owned by PE so all they care about is taking your money. I went to pick up meds today for my cat and they were closed, even though according to their posted hours they should have been open.
took my senior small dog in for a nail trim, they were very patient and kind and did a great job, I already use them as my vet, but will use for nail trim services as well

New employees?
Yes and maybe those who were there last time are still employed but I saw 3 new persons who were on top of things: courteous, friendly as one expects this but one thing that was a new addition and welcoming was the goodies included with my dogs meds. It was a nice thing. Another very welcoming moment was that I just happened to be on the sidewalk right by the Vets front door and began talking with some people when the vet, Nick Kelsey, stepped outside and asked if we were returning and if my dog was ok.
I was appreciative and surprised. He literally stepped out of the “box” to see if we needed help. Thank you Dr. Nick.
Good Vets has a proven decent guy!
We had a great  experience with Dr Flannagan and the staff at GV! Thank you for making us feel welcome and well cared for
Hi, Liz. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Good, but it was way too expensive.
The team is great!  The prices are a little steep!
We needed to see a vet for vaccines as we were in need of boarding. We had a short notice to arrange care. We got prompt excellent care. It was fantastic!
Hi, Yessica. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for trusting us with your pet!

I had to find a vet ASAP because my kitty, Gracie, had a nasty fall. I called and was seen that Friday.  The front staff members was great.. I saw vet and technician on time. Excellent veterinary. Professional and caring. Gracie is feeling and healing well. Absolutely recommend this place for the care of your family pet. Excellent!

If I can give 10 ⭐, I will. They are professional, helpful, and extremely quick service. Easy to make a reservation on their website. My cat has done process to get Health Certificate for pet travel from here. I wish I know about this location before.
Friendly and fast!
Great place and service

My puppy got her first vaccines and check-ups here. They were amazing with her, she was very very comfortable the whole time. They noticed she would benefit from an ear cleaning so she stayed longer and they cleaned her ears and gave us at-home treatments with solution. Highly recommend!
The hospital team is very friendly, informative and attentive  during visits.   On time appointments are much appreciated.
Very friendly and helpful staff. Great experience.
Thank you for the 5 stars! We truly appreciate your support.

Dr. Creger at GoodVets Streeterville is truly incredible! Our dog Margeaux had a broken nail that needed to be removed and was recently sick, and we were feeling pretty nervous since she’s never been sick or injured before. Dr. Creger was so sweet, calm, and attentive throughout our entire visit. She stayed late to carefully rule out any other issues and made sure Margeaux was as comfortable as possible. When she was sick, she called us right away as soon as the results came in to explain everything and talk through next steps. She even followed up a few days later just to check in and see how Margeaux was doing, which meant so much to us. I was so impressed by her genuine care—she treated Margeaux like family. I’ll 100% be going back to see Dr. Creger, and I can’t recommend her enough!

Update:

We’ve had a fantastic experience at GoodVets Streeterville, especially with Dr. Rosen. Our Dalmatian, Piper, was having ongoing GI issues, and from our first visit, Dr. Rosen was incredibly thorough and thoughtful in helping us get to the bottom of everything.

She took the time to explain what could be causing her symptoms, walked us through our options without making us feel overwhelmed, and created a treatment plan that gave us confidence we were on the right track. Throughout the process, we always felt like Piper’s health was her top priority.

The entire team at GoodVets has been friendly, professional, and genuinely caring. It’s such a relief knowing we have a veterinary team we can trust, and we’re so grateful for the care Piper has received. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend GoodVets Streeterville to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care.

We had such a great experience at GoodVets Streeterville! We brought our Frenchie, Bean, in for a routine checkup, and everyone was so kind and welcoming from start to finish.

The whole team made us feel comfortable, answered all of our questions, and took great care of Bean. It’s so nice finding a vet where you know your pup is in good hands. We definitely recommend GoodVets Streeterville!

I cannot say enough good things about the GoodVets in Streeterville! From the moment we walked in, the entire team was warm, welcoming, and incredibly attentive to my dog, Piper.

Josh, in particular, went above and beyond to make sure Piper was comfortable and well cared for. His kindness, patience, and expertise truly made all the difference. It’s clear that everyone here genuinely cares about the animals they treat, and I feel completely confident that Piper was in the best hands.

If you’re looking for a vet that treats your pet like family in Chicago, this is the place to go. Highly recommend!

Update!!!

We’ve had such a wonderful experience at GoodVets Streeterville, and I can’t recommend Dr. Flannagan enough. She is incredibly kind, patient, and knowledgeable, and she always takes the time to make sure all of our questions are answered without ever making us feel rushed.

Our shepherd mix, Margeaux, can be a little nervous at the vet, but Dr. Flannagan has such a calming presence that every visit has been a positive experience. It’s clear she truly cares about her patients and wants what’s best for them.

The entire staff is welcoming, professional, and genuinely loves animals. It’s such a relief knowing Margeaux is in such great hands every time we walk through the door. We feel incredibly lucky to have found this clinic!

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Dr. Flannagan and the team at GoodVets Streeterville. When my doodle, Remi, had a health scare, Dr. Flannagan was everything you could hope for in a veterinarian. She was calm, compassionate, incredibly thorough, and took the time to explain everything in a way that was easy to understand.

During such a stressful situation, she made me feel supported every step of the way and treated Remi with so much care and kindness. It was obvious that she genuinely cared about getting Remi the best possible care, and that meant the world to me.

I’m so grateful we found Dr. Flannagan. If you’re looking for a veterinarian who is knowledgeable, empathetic, and truly loves her patients, I couldn’t recommend her more.

I am at a lost of words for how amazing this establishment is. The staff made sure we were taken care of from the very minute we walked into the door.

Not only did we feel at ease with their care, but was blown away by their expertise. They were knowledgeable and clearly explained our next steps to best care for our baby.

Laura especially was exceptional and truly went above and beyond for us!
Dr. Rosen was lovely! She was honest and compassionate and really helped me through a tough time with my cat (Muffin)

Every visit at the Streeterville location had different vets and vet techs who add to his trauma. We repeatedly say he does not need a muzzle, but they force the muzzle on him during cares because of the vet tech’s inexperience with large breeds. He has never snapped, growled, bared teeth, or barked at a staff member. He cries for his parents because of the repeated trauma he experiences with being manhandled and muzzled. We do not plan to return to this location or Good Vets in general.

Today’s visit started with the vet tech relaying incomplete information to the vet. The vet asked clarifying questions which helped clear the misunderstanding but could have affected our plan of care. Our dog was calm during his physical exam but the vet tech grabbed his harness and yanked on him repeatedly, which caused him to tug against it from the discomfort. When it came time to do the bloodwork, we were not offered the option to do it in the exam room with us. I’m very concerned by the inexperience that ALL the vet techs at this location have with large breeds. They are not confident approaching large breeds and cannot effectively calm an anxious dog. I’m concerned that they label every anxious or fearful dog as “aggressive” due to their inexperience and incompetence. The senior vet tech came into the exam room with a muzzle clearly too small for my dog and insisted on using it despite us telling them that they do not need it and it is traumatizing. They also insisted it was the right size muzzle until I showed them that they were incorrect by attempting to place it on our dog. They had to go back and get a bigger size. After the correct size was obtained, they instructed  the initial vet tech to “hold him from the neck like you’re putting him in a chokehold.” If this is standard practice at GoodVets, then we will not be returning. This is causing more and more trauma to our dog. The happy visits that are offered will not mitigate the actual manhandling and disregard for parent instructions. While the bloodwork was being obtained, our dog did not growl, bark, bare teeth, or show any signs of aggression the entire time. Yet, the vet techs continue to include the use of a muzzle and hard restraining tactics with each visit and are documented with each visit. After the bloodwork was obtained, the senior vet tech asked “did he do anything?” My dog did not move or vocalize or do anything throughout this procedure. We could feel the discomfort and stress of the vet techs around a larger breed. They did not praise him or offer gentle petting. They proceeded to go straight to work and only knew to offer treats for expected behavior. Anyone with experience with pets should know alternative de-escalation methods or calming methods when a fearful dog is no longer treat motivated. Instead, this location escalated straight from treats to muzzling and manhandling. This is not our first experience with them escalating so fast without a chance to calm our dog.

In addition, we were frustrated by the lack of communication throughout this procedure. After obtaining the bloodwork, the vet techs proceeded to leave the examination room without bandaging the site where he was poked for bloodwork and while the muzzle was still attached to my dog. The senior vet tech had to remind the inexperienced ones to properly bandage him prior to leaving the room. I had to stop them again before they left to ask if the muzzle could be removed. Their response was “yeah, sure, go ahead.” I was the one to remove the muzzle. I’m concerned that they walked away without removing it after forcing it on my dog. This adds to the traumatic experience not just for him, but also for us.

We think the vet techs need to be more thoroughly evaluated prior to hiring for experience, emotional management of themselves, and calming techniques. This location specifically can benefit from extensive training regarding large breeds and customer communication. We lost confidence in their expertise and are worried about how much more our dog was traumatized by this experience.
Friendly and professional services.
Always easy to work with.

they got me in right away, super friendly, and where transparent about cost before proceeding with additional care.  would recommend to anyone who struggles to get an appointment with their current vet!
both Jade and Dr Rosen were professional, efficient and thorough.  they answered all our questions and addressed our concerns
I brought my cat for a check-in and I have to say all staff were excellent, super friendly and great customer service.  Thankyou DVM Rosen, Tech Candy and CSR Cindy.

We had one of the most horrible experiences ever here. Rude staff. Horrible communication. The doctor didn’t spend time with our dog. They went straight to X-rays vs doing blood work and a stool sample. This place is all about the money and not the care of the persons animal. I wouldn’t recommend this place to my worst enemy.

Our regular vet. Every doctor we have seen has been incredibly competent and helpful, especially Dr. Rosen. We have been in for annual wellness, surgical consults, and emergency visits. Every time they have treated my aging dog with care and kindness. The staff is friendly and while my dog doesn't love the vet, she knows she can always convince someone to give her a treat at Goodvets. Cannot recommend enough.
Great experience everyone take both my puppy and older dog. Everyone on the team is so caring and knowledgeable. The only vet I will go to!
Love all the staff. Simply the best place to bring your loved fur babies

We took our dog to this GoodVets location for four years.  Let me preface this by saying that most of the actual vets and techs are perfectly good—knowledgable, competent, and personable.  Apart from one incident when our dog sat in a crate for literally SEVEN HOURS waiting for a brief procedure that we were told would take 2-3 hours—with very sparse communication to us in the interim—the care itself was fine.

HOWEVER, GoodVets is the prime embodiment of the price gouging, private-equity-owned vet epidemic in Chicago.  Pricing is exorbitant, and the fee/appointment structure is designed to nudge customers into a TotalCare [subscription] membership.  Part of this model is pushing frequent unnecessary—and very expensive—care.  Our dog is on a fairly mild daily medication for anxiety, and GoodVets would not fill our medication unless we brought her in for bloodwork multiple times per year (on top of normal checkups and other periodic appointments for vaccines and such).  (This is despite the fact that she has been on the medication for years, has never shown a negative reaction, and is perfectly healthy.)  Since switching to another vet, she only gets bloodwork once per year—the actual mandate/recommendation—and we pay the same price for three months of medication that we did for one month at GoodVets.  Odds are high that your young, healthy dog doesn't ACTUALLY need to go to the vet six times per year; be wary of businesses (especially owned businesses) that suggest otherwise.

This practice USED to provide excellent care, but the decline in service has been both disappointing and concerning.

I recently requested a refill for my cat's prescription diet, which is medically necessary due to a severe intolerance to regular food that causes bloody diarrhea. I was initially told the refill could not be authorized because my cat had not been seen in over a year. That statement was incorrect. My cat was seen in July 2025, and the staff eventually acknowledged that fact.

After that, I was told that because my cat's regular veterinarian had moved to a different location, a new veterinarian would need to see him before the prescription could be renewed. Frankly, that explanation makes little sense. The entire purpose of a veterinary practice is continuity of care. My cat's diagnosis, history, and response to treatment are thoroughly documented in his medical record by one of your own veterinarians. If a documented medical condition and treatment plan established by your own provider cannot be relied upon by another veterinarian within the same practice, what does that say about the confidence you have in your own medical records and clinicians?

Are clients expected to start over every time a veterinarian changes locations? Should established diagnoses suddenly become questionable because the original veterinarian is no longer in the building? That rationale undermines the very concept of a group practice.

What is most troubling is that despite being informed that interruption of this diet could result in my cat developing bloody diarrhea, there was no apparent urgency, compassion, or effort to help. The response I received felt focused on generating another office visit rather than ensuring continuity of care for a patient with a known medical condition.

The front desk staff appeared completely unbothered by the situation, despite understanding the potential consequences for my cat. Meanwhile, I continue to receive marketing emails and promotions for care plans, which seem to receive more attention than the needs of actual patients.

After more than four years as a loyal client, I am deeply disappointed. This experience has completely eroded my trust in this practice. I will be transferring all of my pets' care to West Loop Veterinary Care.

Shame on you for treating a loyal client—and more importantly, a sick animal—this way.
Thanks so much for the 5 stars! We look forward to seeing you again.
GoodVets streeterville are the best vets I’ve ever been to. Me and my Bengal cat love them, especially laura who always manages to take the best care of Leo.
Very patient and loving specially during puppy appointment. They took great care of my boy Bandit !

My pet has been treated at Goodvets Streeterville since I brought him home. He’s now five years old, and we just got back from an emergency visit to the office, where Dr. Flanagan and her team (Cindy, Melissa, and Candy) discovered my dog had a pretty serious infection. I went home with antibiotics and painkillers that I got on-site. I was so glad that the office was open on a Saturday, and that it was staffed with such knowledgeable and compassionate treatment providers.
Excellent vet. Straight forward and to the point with reasonable prices. I highly recommend this vet!
100% recommended. They are a very responsible clinic. Thanks to the manager who helped me with everything I needed, you can trust them with your feline and canine children. ❤️

Excellent service, I bring my cat daysi for a exams and consultation, they explain to me all the bio marks comings from the labs and laura went over the action plan for daysi really clear for me, highly recommended place

UPDATE: Now that ive been at GV for a few years, wanted to share that Im still very happy with them and their level of service. My dog drags me there everytime; he loves it!

This was my first time at Good Vets since moving from another area of the city. The location is awesome, the facilities are spotless, and the staff is super friendly. I have a Frenchie, so it was important to me that the staff knew the breed well. They brought so much care and attention to my dog and I'm so appreciative of that!

A most disturbing and dangerous and disgusting experience when we left our dog Charlie with them for a weekend. When we picked him he was shaking and shivering and fully wet with urine. His blanket was completely soaked in his urine. This is animal abuse cruelty. I should have pressed charges against them at the time. The girl who gave him to us could have cared less about his situation and literally said she didn’t know anything about his condition and neglect???

These people tried to pressure me to get my cat checked because she hadnt pooped IN A DAY. They said theyd do a physical exam, 2 - 3 X RAYS (??) AND 2 ENEMAS. I told them i was SURE it was constipation and wasnt sure 3 X rays to confirm it were needed but the girl over the phone insisted, saying the doctor couldnt do it without it. Oh, on top of it, i had to drop my cat off and pick her up. So, i mean, i wouldve never seen these X rays or enemas happened. Lol.

They said on the low end, it'd be $579 (five HUNDRED SEVENTY NINE DOLLARS) and on the high end, it could be $687 !!!!! FOR A CONSTIPATED CAT. I was down to pay the exam just for my own peace of mind but they were trying to take me for a ride. If you go to the doctor and tell them you cant poop, youre bloated and you threw up cause youre full of unpooped poop, theyll just give you a laxative. And that was LITERALLY what i explained to them.

Theyre just trying to get your money and i doubt they care about the pets. Dont expect much from a chain.

I gave my cat strictly wet food, a little bit of coconut oil, and she passed stool within the day. They made it seem like it was a life or death matter and that i was a negligent owner if I didnt take them. WILD.
Shout out to Samantha always helping out! They have great prices and love on your pet like their own 💕 very friendly and respectful 💓
Excellent veterinary care and very friendly staff. They were attentive, knowledgeable, and treated our pet great. Highly recommend.

I brought my cat in that had a severe infection and I surely thought I was going to lose him. However, the ladies at Goodvets (specifically Sam) took him in right away and gave him the proper needs and care for my cat! Now slowly but surely my kitty is getting better and I could not have been happier! Amazing location

I want to leave a really positive review for this GoodVets location.

My dog recently had specialty surgery at another hospital, and GoodVets is his primary veterinary clinic. Unfortunately, during the post-surgery period, he developed an infection that we’ve been managing with the surgical hospital. It eventually reached a point where I was sent home with subcutaneous fluid treatments, which meant I had to administer the injections myself.

As someone who becomes very anxious around medical procedures (I even faint when I have blood drawn), I was honestly very scared and overwhelmed about having to do this on my own.

I reached out to GoodVets to ask if they could help, and they were incredibly kind and understanding. Without hesitation, they offered to help administer the catheter and support my dog during the next two weeks—and they are doing it at little cost.

The surgical hospital is also quite far from me, and I don’t have a car, so I wasn’t able to realistically take him there for this ongoing care. GoodVets stepping in made an enormous difference in making sure he could still get the treatment he needs.

I am extremely grateful for their compassion, professionalism, and willingness to step in during a stressful time. It made a huge difference for both me and my dog, and I truly appreciate the care they provide. We still have two weeks left of treatment.
Had to book a same day visit during a trip with my pet and they were so attentive and friendly! So grateful to their staff!
The Vets are good.
I visited GoodVets for a same day visit for my dog while traveling on business. The staff was very accommodating and helpful. Really took a lot of the worry and stress out of the situation.
candy Diaz did a exceptional job in taking care of my pet dog. She has incredible service and i hope you give her a raise she gets 5 big booms💪🏻💪🏻💪🏻💪🏻💪🏻

GoodVets Streeterville is my new favorite place. Candy and Laura are amazing! Candy was warm and welcoming, she made my dog feel so comfortable. My baby had an ear infection and Laura was great with explaining every step I needed to take to make my dog feel better. Both Laura and Candy answered all my questions and left me fully aware of our care plan. Can’t wait to see them both again.
Amazing vet and staff.

Fraudulent business practice alert! I’ve received notification of two appointments I didn’t make with them.

I initially went to them when my dog had an eye issue shortly after moving to Chicago. Had a health check and a test to make sure he didn’t have a scratch on his cornea. He didn’t and the appointment went fine.

A few months later, I get a notification that I have an appointment coming up. Well, that’s surprising since I never made any appointment after that initial visit. I call them to cancel.

Now a few more months later, I get another notification that I have an appointment in a week. I DON’T. I have tried to call them multiple times to cancel today and no one has answered.

So, let me know crystal clear in writing: I didn’t make the last two appointments. Nor do I want to. I will not return to this place again after this experience. Ever.

We are finally switching from this terrible clinic as our vet who was actually competent has moved to another clinic, so I can let everyone know. We’ve been customers for four years and seen many vets because the turnover here is crazy. The prices have skyrocketed up because this clinic has become private equity owned in the last few years. No one answers your calls or calls you back so you have to fight for care for your pet. They won’t honor diagnoses and suggestions they’ve literally told you before because they want you to come in and pay them before they move forward, it’s so sick. They also make SO many mistakes (telling you your pet is getting the wrong test, not following up to tell you whether your pet needs certain medicines or not, etc) and think you won’t notice—I have medical training so I do notice and had to again, fight for my pet multiple times so they didn’t treat him incorrectly. I beg that you go some place else.

This location was not organized for my most recent visit.

I made an appt for 730pm (they close at 8pm), and called a few times around 7pm with a question - my calls kept going to the automated recording which said they were closed.

I made another appointment for the next day at 1130am and when I got there, they said I wasn’t in the schedule. I even showed the front desk attendant a screenshot of my confirmation, and she kept saying I wasn’t in the system.
She did mention I could wait to see if the Doc could see me after her appointments, but could not give me any range of time. We rescheduled to later in the day.

I don’t think they realize how much a missed appointment can affect someone’s schedule and day, especially on top of having a sick pet and wanting them to get better. The unreliability is so unprofessional!
Always very quick and professional with my babyy Panda

I had several issues with this location (the one in west loop is great). They changed my appointment time without telling me, and offering no appointment times close to what I had. I went in for an international health certificate, and when I went to pick it up, they handed me an envelope ensuring the health certificate was in it, and it was a completely different document. That would’ve seriously messed up our travels. The vet was great, but the ones doing administrative work are beyond frustrating.
The vet and staff were so kind and gentle with our kitten. Clearly communicated the plan and answered any questions/concerns! Very trustworthy and happy to come back for next visits!

They don’t offer the services that they list.

When you make appointments they tell you the vets who can do that aren’t on site— but this is every single consecutive day.

Either the director or the receptionist is unaware of your policies. Either way— remove all service from your website and start over.

I run a luxury travel business and travel internationally, regularly, yalls location has been the worst service I’ve had being back in the United States and that’s pretty bad given that I leave reviews often for poor service.

Get together, find a plan, and then implement it as a team so that you stop lying to your customers.

Have the day you deserve, guys. 🤝🏽
Fabulous place, great doctors very professional and knowledgeable. Shares your concerns of your dogs
Very caring drs and staff

I took my dog in for a case of happy tail. As a new dog mom, I wasn't sure what to expect or do, but I heard about GoodVets through social media, so I said I'd try them out. I took her, and I was greeted warmly by the lady at the front desk. They checked her out and told me what was going on. Again, being a first-time dog mom, I did some research of my own, and I suggested to them docking the tail, considering how bad it had gotten. They assured me that her tail wouldn't need to be docked and that it would get better with medication. So I paid the over $200= bill with the hopes that what I was told was going to happen and my baby would be herself again. I trusted them because they are the professionals, not me. I was giving the medicine like I was told, but her tail never got better. I called to tell them what I was seeing, and I even sent pictures. They wanted me to come in and give her more medication and do blood work. I went and got a second opinion because talking to them put a bad feeling in my stomach. I sent the same images to other places so I could compare, and they all said the same thing:" The tail needs to be docked, it is badly infected". I went ahead and changed her to another doctor. One day, they called me wanting to check in on her and get her scheduled for another appointment, to which I said no. I told them that I took her somewhere else because they couldn't provide me with what I needed, and the lady I was talking to had a bit of an attitude when I told her that I wouldn't be bringing my baby back to them ever again. The whole experience felt like a money thing instead of making sure that my baby was properly taken care of, and that she was no longer in any pain, and getting to the root of the problem.
Dr. Rosen was amazing with my dog Bubbles! I recommend this location 100% the receptionist and tech were alll so kind! And BUBBLES APPRECIATES YOUU SO MUCH THANK YOU❤️❤️
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’d really appreciate the chance to talk more about your experience, please contact the hospital directly so we can address your concerns.
I love love this place and its employees. They are all so wonderful, beautiful, caring loving women. They are the best and they handled my little angel with tender love and care‼️❤️🥰

Wow!! Thank you so much to The GoodVets Streeterville location for going above and beyond for me and my fur baby! All of the techs there are so amazing and friendly! The doctors on site are phenomenal and genuinely caring! From the second I walked into their office, I knew this would be the only Vet I’d ever go to!!
Laura and Sam were the most amazing, friendly, and loving people and they really helped me and my baby girl Korra feel right at home!

Thank you for everything GoodVets Streeterville

I highly recommend this  clinic! They always take such good care of my pets and truly treat them like their own. The doctors are knowledgeable, the technicians are amazing, and the staff is always so kind and friendly. It’s clear that everyone here really cares about animals and the families who love them. I’m so grateful to have found such a wonderful clinic!

My two cats, Aspen and Bijou, have been patients at GoodVets for about two years now. Both cats have somewhat complex health histories, so finding a veterinarian who is skilled and compassionate has always been a top priority for me.

That’s why I want to give a shoutout to Dr. Post! She is a truly outstanding vet -- extremely knowledgeable, meticulous, and incredibly attentive. Every appointment feels personalized, and she always takes the time to explain her diagnoses and recommendations in detail, which is something I deeply value as a very anxious pet parent.

I know Aspen and Bijou are in great hands with her and the GoodVets team!

Wonderful experience with Dr Creger!

My old vet was moving and I was looking for a new vet in the area which can be a stressful process. I found Dr Creger at GoodVets Streeterville and am so glad I did.

Dr Creger and all the staff at GoodVets Streeterville took great care of my fur baby. They were very patient with me (I ask a lot of questions) and very reassuring and gentle with my kitty.

When some bloodwork numbers looked a bit strange, Dr Creger was honest with me and recommended what she would do for her own fur baby. This reassured me that Dr Creger was looking after my kitty as she would look after her own.

Thank you Dr Creger and all the awesome staff at GoodVets Streeterville.

Also great Wellness Plan payment program which pays off because Chicago prices can be hefty.

WorstVets! Do not go here unless you want people who don’t care about your pets health and just care about selling more products and adding on unnecessary tests!!

We took my sick puppy to them, they ordered ALL the tests and promised results within 24 to MAX 48 hours. They just sent us home with NO medicine. It’s been 64+ hours now and nothing. Calling the clinic only gets you ignored. The main doctor came 35 mins late and left within 15 mins. Questions have been left unanswered. When I called again saying my puppy is still super sick and he needs some kind of meds, they asked us to go to book another appointment!

Save your peace and go somewhere else.

Also they are super mismanaged! They charged us twice. Did not send over the itemized invoice (we had to call twice for that as well!) , and there are no notes shared from the visit.

No results even though we were promised blood work and fecal results within 48 hours by Doctor Kreiger. We were made to wait for over 40 mins before the Doctor came to check. Left in 15 mins "to answer another phone call" and never came back. She was supposed to call us for questions, but obviously never did. We spent over $500 (blood work, fecal test, doctor's visit) and came out with nothing. When we tried calling them for the results - they said we should take our dog to the ER if he is still not doing well. He was given no medication. Save your money and go to another veterinary!

Their prices are out of control. Same test one year ago was 80 dollars- this year it’s 120 and they now charge a 34 dollar tech fee as well to take the dog behind the counter for 3 seconds making it about 75 dollars more in one year. Go elsewhere
I brought my cat here for a comprehensible examination and grooming session. The staff was helpful and kind. While the prices were slightly elevated, the overall services were good.
Horrible management. High turnover. They really just need to close this place. The only good doctor there is Dr. Post.

I’m a proud dog mom to two vibrant pugs — Miko and Dahli — and we’ve been happy clients of GoodVets Streeterville for a couple of years now. We originally followed Dr. Post from a previous practice that had closed, and we’ve never looked back. Every visit here is a joy — the girls feel like total superstars from the moment we walk in.

While not every visit lines up with Dr. Post’s schedule, every doctor and tech we’ve encountered has been kind, thorough, and genuinely caring. It really feels like a true veterinary family.

One visit in particular stands out: Dr. Creger suggested I look into their Wellness Savings Plan. I was skeptical at first — I’ve never done pet insurance and usually assume these types of plans are gimmicks. But she took the time to walk me through everything, breaking down exactly how the plan works and what kind of savings it offers. Her patience and transparency convinced me to give it a try — and I’m so glad I did.

Funny how timing works: not long after, both dogs needed dental cleanings and extractions, one developed a recurring ear infection, and they both have nails that seem to grow overnight. We’ve been in biweekly lately, and all those appointments — which would have easily cost thousands — were almost entirely covered. Each time I check out and owe nothing or next to nothing, I’m honestly shocked.

We truly love this place. The entire team has made us feel so supported, and I can’t recommend the Wellness Plan enough. It really does deliver on its promise, and if you’re like me — someone who would do anything for your pets — this plan helps you care for them without breaking the bank. That just means more left over for treats, toys, and extra belly rubs!
Dr.Post is the best! She is very knowledgeable and nice. She answered all the questions patiently and professionally. I’m glad poopoo is under her care!

I don’t know if their hours are wrong on Google or if they just don’t answer their phones, but I have tried to reach them several times during hours when they say they are open (9:15am on a Wed, 11am on a Thursday) and their phone system says they are closed.  I’ve also left a message before and they never got back to me, frustrating experience especially as a returning customer..

Tl;dr poor communication, oversight, and high turnover. I booked an appointment for my cat to establish care and get his 2nd FVRCP booster—due April 19th, 2025. When I called to schedule, I explicitly confirmed that coming in shortly after that date would be fine. They said it wouldn't be a problem.

I also sent his full vaccination record on March 24th, which clearly stated he needed his 2nd FVRCP booster by 4/19/25, and his rabies renewal was due March 2026.

Fast forward to today’s appointment: the vet tells me my cat doesn’t need a booster. Had I not pushed back and asked questions, they would have let me leave with an undervaccinated cat—exposed to one of the most common and contagious viruses in urban areas (Chicago included!). They even suggested my cat had already received the booster—despite the fact that the due date was in the future. That makes no sense.

Now, because of their mistake, we have to restart the FVRCP series entirely, meaning more shots for my cat, more cost for me, and more stress all around. And yes, they know I have another cat at home—yet they were prepared to just let this slide?

The constant staff turnover and lack of attention to detail give me little confidence. We’ve scheduled the necessary booster to get things back on track, but I will not be returning for future care. Hoping to find a more established, consistent practice that prioritizes accuracy and the health of all pets in the household.

Incredibly horrible experience with Dr. Post. Very unprofessional with both cat and owners. Refused to look at our cat’s wound properly - only after some convincing from vet tech did she burrito and look. When we asked about storing the gabapentin that she prescribed and she point blank said “I don’t know ask the vet tech”. Will not be coming back.

I cannot say enough good things about GoodVets! When my dog injured her leg on a Friday night, I was panicked and expecting a long, stressful wait. But they got us in within minutes and took such incredible care of her. Josh, Dr. Ennis, and Kelsey went above and beyond to make sure she was comfortable and well taken care of. Their kindness, professionalism, and genuine compassion made a stressful situation so much easier. I am beyond grateful for their quick response and excellent care. Highly recommend GoodVets to anyone looking for top-tier veterinary service!

EDIT: Adding relevant correction to the below: the prescription Josh claimed to have called in, the one I have requested for weeks, was NOT called into the pharmacy. I assume to try and get patients to get a smaller supply for more money. The willful neglect of their animal patients has to be illegal...

I was taking my cat here since 2020, and will never trust this facility again. The negativity radiates throughout and the communication and lack of care in the past year has been beyond appalling. You can call, you'll be ignored. You can email, you will be ignored. You can go into the practice and speak to a human, you will still be ignored! A tech at the practice literally told me to "RUN" last year and that they do not value the quality of life of the pets they treat. They are no longer an employee there.

Not only do vet techs and vets constantly leave the practice, creating more stress for the animals, the Vet Manager Josh is someone I would never trust. I brought my cat in on Monday for a scheduled Solencia injection (which increased in price by $50 since last year) to be told that a vet tech scheduled the appointment incorrectly and there were "supply chain" issues. I asked why no one had communicated that with me before I gave my cat two days of Gabapentin and came there. "We were hopeful!" Josh then said he would reach out personally and even come to my apartment to administer the injection. He sent an email that day, and then never returned a single email from me.

By Friday, I called the office directly and was told that Solencia had been in stock since Tuesday. I had to bring in my cat last minute, stressed. The entire lobby smelled like dog feces. They took her in the back (something I don't allow normally because she stays calmer if she can see me) and the vet tech rudely handed the carrier to me. I've NEVER seen my cat as stressed as she was that day, and she even pooped in her carrier, something she has never done in 15 years. The front desk told me Josh had been in the office that week, but doesn't work Fridays. I told them I was still waiting for a refill on a medication-- of course they only wrote 2 refills for this. This was now my 5th attempt at a refill because they don't provide their email/fax (don't have one apparently) to the pharmacy to be contacted directly for refills.

I called in today, days later, and stated I'm once again requesting refills for my cat. Not only did they call my cat the wrong name, they then placed me on a hold for 13 minutes while they called the pharmacy-- you couldn't just do it and call me back to confirm? Once confirmed, I had to ask if this was Josh. It was. He, of course, blamed the pharmacy and accused them of giving me the run around... I told him I had no issue with the pharmacy, my issue was with the vet practice who refused to call in the refill for 10+ days.  I then asked why he offered services he had no intention of providing and ignored my emails. He claimed he had a family emergency and no one in the office knew. This is beyond nonsensical-- if you can't work, you put an OOO on. If you have tasks you can't complete, you delegate. These aren't office tasks, these are LIVE ANIMALS. There was absolutely not accountability, no apology, no integrity. To blame neglecting my cat's care on FAMILY is repugnant. If I hadn't called, yet again, my cat would still not have her medication.

So if you hate your pet, take them here. If you love your pet, please go somewhere else, as all that matters to Goodvets is greed, ego, and ignoring their patients.

Had a great visit taking my dog here for a cough. The front desk staff was very nice and friendly, talking to me while I waited to be seen. I think their name was Josh or John. DR. Creger was so friendly with my puppy it was like she was treating one of her own dogs. She made sure that I understood everything in Lehman terms and what the game plan was for treating my boy. Will be switching all future vet care to here. Couldn’t recommend more.

We'd been coming to this location for 4+ years with 3 pets. GoodVets recently cancelled a food prescription in order to force an exam even though the the pets were just in for exams a few months ago and the prescription was good for the full year. Also, it meant that we were scrambling for food for our elderly cat.

I tried to rectify the issue with the prescription over the phone but they required that I make an exam appointment. When I came to the office to fix the issue, they couldn't work toward solution and the veterinarian moved to tone police me - a very, very tired story for this woman of color.

They made the conditions of absurdity and tried to blame me for it which is a no go. I will be finding a new vet.

I've been going to GoodVets Streeterville for more than 1.5 years and up until recently, the previous visits have all been good.

Last month I took my cat to GoodVets because my cat is not eating as much as she was before:
- First, they don't do regular tests in the room in front of you anymore - they took your pet back to do all the tests, which was fine. However, while I was waiting, I kept hearing very loud laughs and chats back there, which makes me super anxious because I don't know how alarming their noise could be for my cat, or any other pets back there. I thought it is normal sense for a practice like this to act gently in front of those potentially timid and ill animals.
- Second, although they're open until 8, they cannot do any bloodwork at/after 7. After they found my cat was having a fever, they told me I need to take my cat to ER (which I did) because their staff for bloodwork has already left. To me, if you're open and some of your staff that does critical jobs left before you close, that doesn't really mean "open" to me.
- Third, after my cat's ER visit (nothing critical was found, she's doing perfectly fine, except still not eating as much as before), I took her back to GoodVets to do a followup checkup and this time after her bloodwork, the doctor told me she didn't find anything alarming, except one result in my cat's bloodwork, which she'd need to consult Goodvet's internist about. She told me the feedback loop is 1-2 days and I'll hear from them soon.

Up until this point when I'm writing this review, I still haven't heard from this doctor or this practice wrt their internist's opinion on my cat's result. I called several times asking about this and their receptionist was very apologetic and told me this doctor was having a procedure and she'd reach out soon. This receptionist also told me their internal timeline of internist feedback loop changed so it would take longer to hear from them. Our pets are our kids and I still don't understand why I haven't heard a thing from this doctor after this long.

While waiting, I've already took my cat to another practice, where everything get solved within an appointment. It is really unfortunate that I have to switch to another practice because GoodVets is very close to where I live. However, I cannot risk my pet's life on an irresponsible practice like this.
Everything went smoothly. One of the vet techs, Destinee, was super sweet and very informative! Felt comfortable bringing my cat here, she was in good hands.
Great, friendly service, our vet tech Destinee was very kind and professional. Highly recommend.

Good Vets Streeterville has always treated both me and my dog with tender loving care. My dog Sprinkles loves Vet Tech Destinee and lets her do anything to her. That’s highly unusual because she’s very selective.

i had an amazing experience at good vets streeterville. my 12 year old yellow lab zoey was treated with gentle compassion and care by the vet techs specifically destinee and i will absolutely be recommending this vet to all of my friends. zoey has pretty bad anxiety, especially at the vet, and destinee was gentle and patient with her and made our experience way less hectic than usual.

Dr. Creger and Laura did an amazing job treating my dog. They were both so kind, professional, and thorough in their care. Laura was gentle and reassuring, making sure my pet felt comfortable throughout the visit. Highly recommend this place !!!!

No more visit for me.

I’ve always had great experiences with Dr. Post, and the last visit was no exception. I appreciate the extra care and attention she provides. Though sometimes she made me feel like I asked stupid questions. (I mean duh that’s why I go to a vet).

Unfortunately, I have to take 4 stars off because of my experience with the vet assistant. While she was friendly at the start, her attitude changed once I started asking questions. She seemed unhappy, rushed through explanations, and hurried off without looking back.

When she gave me my cat’s medications, she spoke very quickly and rushed through the instructions. I tried to ask for clarification, but she answered just as quickly and left before I could ask more questions. It felt dismissive and unprofessional, especially compared to my previous visit, where another vet assistant made sure to ask, “Are there any more questions?” before leaving.

I understand I might have booked the wrong type of visit (i made mistakes- and I apologize), but that doesn’t justify being rude. My cat deserves BETTER CARE, and I’m genuinely sad because I love Dr. Post, but this experience makes me hesitant to return.

Goodvets Streeterville always does a phenomenal job from the moment of check in to all the way through the visit. I know my dog is getting the best care and treat him like their own. Huge shout out to Nurse Caroline for our excellent visit today - she took great care of my pup during his vaccinations!

Great experience! Destinee was wonderful with my cats. She was super gentle and clipped their nails very quickly! The whole team was wonderful and I’ll definitely be back. Thank you for taking such good care of my kitties especially my super shy one!

*****SHADY COMPANY*****
My dog was due for 2 vaccinations this month. Last week when I made the appointment I explained to the employee that I travel between CA and IL, so Scofie has a vet in CA as well. He was due for a rabies shot last month and I was in CA at the time—so I got it done there. She told me it was fine and to send them the paperwork so their records could be up to date. She also said it was fine for me to schedule the shots with a vet tech (that way I don’t have to pay extra just for a vet to do another exam and give the same shots a tech could administer).

Fast forward to today, a different employee called me 30 MINUTES before my apt to tell me that Scofie needed to see a vet for the rabies shot. So again, I clarified and immediately sent the paperwork. She said it was okay and that I’m good for my apt with the vet tech. She then calls me again a few min later to tell me that actually… even though Scofie got a full health exam LAST MONTH with his rabies shot, I’m required to schedule with the vet and get ANOTHER full exam today. I used to work in sales and this girl was like a VERY pushy salesperson. I felt her really trying to pressure me into making this apt. She kept casually brushing off my concerns/issues with this situation and would go back to saying something like, “so 5:30 with the vet is okay?” She even said that the girl I spoke to last week was “new” and didn’t know the “rules” and my pet “needs to see the vet once a year to establish a relationship.”

…What a load of crap. That is such a stupid reason to make me pay an extra $100 for a full exam THAT I ALREADY DID LAST MONTH. I don’t want to pay $100 “to establish a relationship.” My dog’s health is important to me and my vet in CA already cleared that. He’s barely going to have a relationship with a vet he sees once a year anyways.

What a shame because I really liked our vet and my previous experience with them as a company was positive. I’m moving to a new area in Chicago next month and I was originally going to transfer to a different GoodVets location. ABSOLUTELY NOT anymore. I’d rather spend $100 to find a new place that doesn’t try to come up with ridiculous reasons to charge someone instead of being reasonable. This whole situation has made me lose trust in GoodVets entirely. It’d be 0 stars from me if it weren’t for the lovely woman I originally spoke to last week and the great vet we saw last time. Unfortunately, poor, shady company practices alone have lost GoodVets any and all business from me.

I have been taking my cats to GoodVets over the last 5 years of living in River North/Streeterville and have experienced a steady decline in both vet care and communication, as well as a steady increase in overcharging and upselling. I have hesitated to write this review because there are certainly veterinarians at this practice that have really helped my cats when they were sick with gastritis, pancreatitis, ear mites, etc and worked with me to over the course of a year to address one of my cat's anxiety/behavioral issues (namely Dr. Patrick Schauer, who is no longer at this location). However, my partner and I have now been overcharged or upsold on everything from the cost of anesthesia, IV fluids, prescription medications, to lab errors and "senior" comprehensive studies on my 5 year old cat. We have dropped off a sick cat for an exam under anesthesia only to hear nothing from the clinic for several days about the results of her very expensive exam or what we should do about her new urinary incontinence. The final straw for me was taking my cat in on Monday for hair loss and being sent home with a prescription for gabapentin 50 mg 28 capsules that cost $60. I asked if I could use my other cat's existing gabapentin prescription and just split the dose, but was told the dosing couldn’t be guaranteed.  I understood the vet's point, so just swiped my card at the end of the visit and didn't look further until tonight. Cat #1's gabapentin prescription cost me $0.66/pill for 100 mg pill, I was charged $2.14/pill for a 50 mg pill on the new prescription. If you consider that the new Rx is half the dose, then I am paying $4 for 100 mg for one cat and $0.66 cents for the other cat. The overall feel of the care we receive now is very private equity, profit driven veterinary care, which is disheartening knowing how wonderful and pet loving so many of the employees at this location have been over the past 5 years. Many of the vets are young, smart doctors and truly do care about your pets, but veterinary care has become so profit driven and infiltrated by investors with no interest in your pet’s health that I think they find themselves caught in the middle of this unfortunate circumstance. If you can find another veterinary practice in this area that is locally or family owned, I would encourage you to go there (and provide me with the recommendation).

I had an unsettling experience with my puppy's veterinarian recently. My puppy was due for his last DHPP booster shot on November 11th with his 3rd round done on October 11, but apparently bringing him on November 11 was considered three days late. When I arrived at the clinic, I was told that because I was even a few days late, they would have to restart the last booster vaccination and administer ANOTHER round. This felt unnecessary and overly strict, especially since we were only talking about a three-day delay.

I understand the importance of vaccinations, but it seemed excessive to me. I was made to feel like I had done something irresponsible, when in reality, the delay was very minor. On another note, the treats they fed my puppy had him PUKING an hour after.

What really frustrated me was the lack of flexibility or willingness to discuss alternative options. Instead of acknowledging the reasonable circumstances behind the delay, the clinic’s stance felt more like a rigid policy rather than a tailored approach to the situation. In the end, I was forced to pay for and go through a process I thought could have been avoided, which was frustrating both emotionally and financially.

While I understand the importance of keeping on top of vaccination schedules, this experience left me feeling as though the vet's office was more focused on profit than providing compassionate care or understanding. I really hope other pet owners don’t face the same strict interpretation of the rules, as it was an unnecessary inconvenience for both me and my puppy.

I’m extremely disappointed with the experience at GoodVets taking my girlfriend there. They seemed more focused on upcharging and pushing unnecessary visits than on actually caring for my puppy. Despite having taken my puppy in for his vaccination EXACTLY ONE month ago, they insisted on restarting his last booster vaccination just because he was a 3 days late—mind you, his last vaccination was October 11th and I came in November 11th for what I thought would be his last and final round of shots, which still costed me $130+! I will NOT be scheduling ANOTHER booster round just for being 3 days late. My puppy also PUKED right after his appointment from whatever treats they fed him.

To make things worse, the person that picked up my phone call a few days prior was rude and dismissive. They made me feel like a burden instead of a valued client. I’m all for thorough care, but the constant upselling and lack of warmth from the staff make it clear that this place is more about profit than pets. I won’t be coming back, and I wouldn’t recommend GoodVets to anyone looking for genuine care and transparency.

I am not sure these 5 star reviews are genuine FYI.
